sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find all green blocks
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")
targets = []
for n in green_nodes:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    center_row = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    center_col = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    targets.append((center_row, center_col))
    print(f"  Block at ({center_row}, {center_col}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Collect all 7 green blocks
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in targets], intent='solve')
print(f"\nAfter 7 MOUSE: done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
colors = {}
for n in nodes:
    colors[n['color']] = colors.get(n['color'], 0) + 1
print(f"Color counts: {colors}")

# Check if green blocks remain
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(green_nodes)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
